description: The balance used to weigh lactose was one day past its calibration due date. A check with certified weights the same day was within tolerance.
classification_rationale: The as-found check was within tolerance, so the weighed quantities are not in doubt.
root_cause: The calibration due date was not flagged in the equipment scheduling system.
immediate_actions: Tagged the balance out of use
Performed an as-found check with certified weights

description: Capsule fill weights exceeded the upper action limit for 25 minutes. In-process checks show three samples above the registered specification.
classification_rationale: Product outside the registered specification may have been produced; the affected portion can be identified by time.
root_cause: The dosing disc was set to the wrong height after a changeover.
immediate_actions: Segregated containers filled during the 25-minute window
Reset and verified the dosing disc height

description: A fragment of a damaged punch tip was found missing during end-of-run tooling inspection. The metal detector the batch passed through was later found to be switched off.
classification_rationale: Possible metal contamination of product with no effective detection control creates a direct patient safety risk.
root_cause: The metal detector was not re-enabled after cleaning, and the line start checklist did not require a challenge test.
immediate_actions: Quarantined the tablet press and tooling

description: Coating pan inlet air temperature was 1 degree C above the batch record range for 4 minutes. Coating weight gain, appearance and dissolution met specification.
classification_rationale: The excursion was brief and small, and all affected quality attributes met specification.
root_cause: The temperature controller overshot after a spray pause.
immediate_actions: Reviewed the process trend for the whole run

description: A line clearance check found 12 printed cartons from the previous lot under the cartoner. Reconciliation showed none had entered the current run.
classification_rationale: A failed line clearance creates a mix-up risk, even though no cartons from the previous lot were used.
root_cause: The line clearance checklist did not include the area under the cartoner.
immediate_actions: Removed and destroyed the stray cartons
Repeated line clearance with a second verifier

description: A cold room storing finished vials, labelled for storage at 2 to 8 degrees C, reached 14 degrees C for 11 hours overnight. The alarm did not reach the on-call phone.
classification_rationale: A long excursion outside the labelled storage range needs a stability assessment, and a monitoring control failed.
root_cause: The alarm dialler held an outdated on-call number.
immediate_actions: Placed all affected stock on hold
Corrected the on-call number and tested the alarm

description: An HPLC system suitability injection failed the tailing factor limit. The sequence was stopped before any sample result was generated.
classification_rationale: No reportable results were generated on the unsuitable system.
root_cause: The analytical column had reached the end of its useful life.

description: An operator reached over open sterilized stoppers during aseptic filling. No intervention was recorded at the time, and the event was found on video review.
classification_rationale: A breach of aseptic technique over exposed sterile components compromises sterility assurance, which testing cannot restore.
root_cause: The stopper bowl layout requires operators to reach across it to clear a common jam.
immediate_actions: Suspended the operator's aseptic qualification pending retraining

description: Wet massing ran 30 seconds longer than the batch record range. Granule moisture, particle size and downstream blend uniformity met specification.
classification_rationale: The overrun was small and in-process results show no effect on the granulate.
root_cause: The mixer timer was started manually and stopped late.
immediate_actions: Reminded the shift to use the recipe timer

description: The second-person verification signature is missing for one excipient weighing. The balance printout confirms the correct material code and quantity.
classification_rationale: Independent printed evidence confirms the material and quantity; the gap is in documentation.
root_cause: The verifier was called away before signing.
immediate_actions: Reconciled the balance printout against the batch record

description: Tablet hardness fell below the lower specification limit for an estimated 40 minutes after a hopper level sensor failed. Tablets from that period went into the bulk container.
classification_rationale: Out-of-specification tablets were mixed into bulk product, so the whole container is affected until assessed.
root_cause: The failed sensor let the hopper run low, which changed die filling.
immediate_actions: Placed the bulk container on hold

description: The post-use integrity test of the sterilizing filter failed and failed again on retest. The filled vials rely on this filter for sterility.
classification_rationale: A confirmed sterilizing filter integrity failure means the product cannot be assured sterile.
root_cause: Under investigation; a damaged filter seal was observed on removal.

description: The vision system rejected no packs during its start-up challenge because a rejection arm was disconnected. This was found before the packaging run started.
classification_rationale: The failure was found by the start-up control before any product was packed.
root_cause: The air line to the rejection arm was not reconnected after maintenance.

description: Two pallets of released and quarantined vials were found in the same marked bay. Status labels were intact and stock records show no movement of quarantined stock.
classification_rationale: Physical segregation of quarantined stock failed, creating a mix-up risk.
root_cause: The quarantine bay was full and no overflow location was defined.
immediate_actions: Moved quarantined stock to a segregated area
Verified stock status against the inventory system

description: An analyst recorded a dissolution bath temperature on loose paper and transcribed it to the worksheet later. The original paper was discarded.
classification_rationale: Discarding an original GMP record is a data integrity failure, whether or not the value was transcribed correctly.
root_cause: The worksheet was not available at the instrument.
immediate_actions: Reviewed the instrument log for the temperature
Briefed analysts on original record requirements

description: A dryer room door was left open for about 2 minutes during drying. Room differential pressure alarmed and recovered; no other product was exposed in the area.
classification_rationale: The brief loss of pressure differential had no product exposure pathway.
root_cause: The door closer was worn and did not latch.
immediate_actions: Raised a work order for the door closer

description: Cartons printed with the wrong expiry date, six months later than the batch record, were applied to finished packs. The error was found at final QA inspection before release.
classification_rationale: An overstated expiry date could expose patients to expired product; detection relied on the last control before release.
root_cause: The printer recipe was copied from a previous lot and the date check was signed without comparison to the batch record.

description: A scoop labelled for a different excipient was found in the dispensing booth after dispensing had finished. The cleaning log shows the scoop was not used for this lot.
classification_rationale: Records show the scoop was not used, so there was no cross-contamination pathway.
root_cause: The booth clearance did not list utensils individually.
immediate_actions: Added utensils to the booth clearance checklist

description: An environmental monitoring settle plate in the Grade A zone grew one colony during filling. Media fill history and other locations for the session showed no growth.
classification_rationale: Any growth in the Grade A zone exceeds the action limit and requires investigation of batch impact.
root_cause: Under investigation; organism identification is pending.
immediate_actions: Reviewed intervention records for the session

description: The coating solution was held 2 hours beyond its validated hold time before use. It was used to coat the full batch.
classification_rationale: Using a material beyond its validated hold time puts microbial quality outside the validated state.
root_cause: The preparation time was not written on the solution vessel label.
immediate_actions: Requested microbial testing of the coated tablets
Added preparation and expiry times to vessel labels
